name: Valence-flip = a gate reading
mechanism: A closing gate converts approach-intent into avoidance-intent (Higgins prevention focus; Bandura: low efficacy pushes away). Same driver, opposite valence across rooms = the room did it.
trigger_expr: same driver reads approach in one situation, avoidance in another → fire “context-sensitive gate.”
sibling_or_null: Null: valence stable across contexts → gate isn’t biting → silent.
confidence_rule: MIN(conf of the two valence readings)
render_template: The same pull runs toward what you want in some rooms and away from being caught out in others. That flip is the room talking, not you.

name: Empathy needs feedback air
mechanism: Empathy is exercised only where response returns (Bronfenbrenner proximal processes). A sealed loop gives it nothing to work on.
trigger_expr: Empathy ≥ high AND env-need = Feedback → gate OPEN, surfaces. Empathy high AND room = Insulated → suppressed; do-channel under-reads.
render_template: Your read on people comes alive in rooms where you hear back. Seal off the response and it goes quiet — not because it’s gone, but because it has nothing to answer.

name: Conviction under blame
mechanism: Safety lets conviction show as forward positions; blame inverts it into defensive self-protection (regulatory-focus flip).
trigger_expr: Conviction high AND room=Safe → bold positions. Conviction high AND room=Blame → reads as rigidity / withdrawal.
render_template: In a room where it’s safe to be wrong, your conviction shows up as clear positions. In a blaming room the same strength turns into guarding yourself — same fuel, defensive gear.

name: Systems needs a cross-disciplinary room
mechanism: Systems thinking needs several domains in the room to connect; a silo starves it of the parts it links.
trigger_expr: Systems ≥ high AND room=Silo → under-reads; needs CrossDisc to surface.
render_template: You connect things across boundaries — so a siloed team gives you less to connect. Your systems sense needs other disciplines in the room to reach across.

name: Analytical opens in a challenge
mechanism: Analytical drive is fed by a genuine puzzle (Hidi–Renninger; Piaget equilibration). Routine removes the disequilibrium it runs on.
trigger_expr: Analytical high AND room=Challenge → engaged. AND room=Routine → dulls.
render_template: Give you a real problem and the analysis switches on. Give you a settled routine and the same capacity has nothing to bite — it needs a puzzle to run.

name: Making needs a resourced room
mechanism: Material/craft capacity needs tools and materials to be expressed; a bare room hides it.
trigger_expr: Making high AND room=Bootstrapped → can’t show; needs Resourced.
render_template: Your hands know things — but only where there’s material to work. A bare-bones setup hides a capacity a stocked workshop would show in a day.

name: Explorers stall in launch-only rooms
mechanism: Exploration drivers feed on open problems; a launch-only room offers no open ground, and approach can flip to Security-avoidance.
trigger_expr: dominant drivers = Creation or Understanding AND room=Launch-heavy → gate closes; watch Security-avoidance appear.
sibling_or_null: Null: dominant driver not an explorer type → n/a.
render_template: You’re pulled toward figuring-out and making-new. A room that’s only about shipping the known gives that pull nowhere to go — and it can quietly turn into playing safe.

name: The substrate read (parametric)
mechanism: Capability is trained skill; capacity is the raw material under it. Skill without substrate has a low ceiling; substrate without skill is a fast build.
trigger_expr: cap high + capability low → “fast build”. cap low + capability high → “trained past substrate”. both high → “realised”. both low → “cold”.
sibling_or_null: Null: — (always classifies into one of four quadrants).
render_template: The raw material is there and the training isn’t yet — this is a gap that closes fast, not a ceiling. (Reads the four quadrants; the render adapts to which one you’re in.)

name: Eye ahead of the tool
mechanism: Taste is the slow thing to grow; software is the fast thing. A high eye over thin tools is the good direction of the gap.
trigger_expr: Aesthetic high AND Digital low → “fast build”.
sibling_or_null: Sibling S4 (inverse). Null: Aesthetic not high → n/a.
render_template: Your eye is ahead of your software. That’s the good direction of the gap — taste is the slow thing to grow, tools are the fast thing.

name: Reads people, hasn’t learned the methods
mechanism: The instinct to read people is the rare, slow-built part; research method is teachable on top of it.
trigger_expr: Empathy high AND Research low → “fast build”. Empathy high AND Research present → “realised” (compounds).
render_template: You read people instinctively but may not have been taught the methods to do it rigorously. Method is teachable; the instinct under it is the rare part — and you have it.

name: Systems sense under trained research
mechanism: A systems instinct gives trained research real material to work on; the two compound rather than substitute.
trigger_expr: Systems high AND Research present → “realised”, compounding.
render_template: Your instinct for how parts connect sits under trained research — so the method has real material to work on, and the two compound.

name: Trained past the taste (inverse warning)
mechanism: Polish can outrun the underlying eye; that’s the slower gap to close, and worth naming honestly.
trigger_expr: Aesthetic low AND Digital high → “trained past substrate”.
sibling_or_null: Sibling of S1. Null: Aesthetic not low → n/a.
render_template: You can execute cleanly, but the underlying eye is thinner than the toolkit. That’s the slower gap — worth knowing which way yours runs.

name: Analytically-earned conviction
mechanism: Analytical work is the mechanism by which conviction becomes reliable — not two scores that happened to co-occur.
trigger_expr: Conviction high AND Analytical high → “earned”.
sibling_or_null: Sibling: Conviction high + Analytical low → “gut-led”. Null: Conviction not high → silent.
render_template: Your conviction is analytically earned — when you dig in, it’s because you’ve done the work to back it. Hard to move with rhetoric, easy to move with evidence.

name: Warm-analytical read
mechanism: Analytical capacity disciplines empathy from projection toward verified understanding.
trigger_expr: Empathy high AND Analytical high → “checked warmth”.
sibling_or_null: Sibling: Empathy high + Analytical low → “intuitive empathy”. Null: Empathy not high → silent.
render_template: You feel your way into people and then check it against what’s actually there — warmth that doesn’t skip the evidence.

name: Deliberate originality
mechanism: The drive to make-new, tempered by carefulness, produces considered originality rather than reckless novelty.
trigger_expr: Creation-drive AND Careful → “brakes wired in”.
sibling_or_null: Sibling: Creation + Bold → “fast maker, leaps first”. Null: Creation not dominant → silent.
render_template: You’re pulled to make new things, but you look before you leap — originality with the brakes wired in, not despite them.

name: Opinionated eye
mechanism: Aesthetic capacity flavoured by conviction yields a point of view rather than a chameleon’s adaptability.
trigger_expr: Aesthetic high AND Conviction high → “taste with a spine”.
render_template: Your taste comes with a spine — you back your aesthetic calls rather than bending to the room. A point of view, not a mirror.

name: Deep pull, wide field
mechanism: A pull to go deep colliding with genuine breadth of ability makes CHOOSING, not ability, the friction.
trigger_expr: Deep AND three-or-more capacities high → fire.
sibling_or_null: Null: fewer than three high capacities → n/a.
render_template: You want to go all the way in — but you’re genuinely good at several things pulling different ways. The hard part isn’t ability, it’s choosing where to spend the depth.

name: Strong positions, needs the echo
mechanism: Holding firm views while needing response can collide — the risk is digging in before listening.
trigger_expr: Conviction high AND env-need=Feedback → fire.
render_template: You hold strong positions and you need to hear back from people — and those can collide. The watch-point is digging in before you’ve fully listened.

name: The maker who wants safe ground
mechanism: The forward pull to make and the backward pull to safety are both real; naming the friction beats pretending one wins.
trigger_expr: Creation-approach AND Security-avoidance both present → fire.
render_template: What pulls you forward — making the new thing — and what holds you back — wanting solid ground — are both strong in you. Neither is wrong; the friction is real and worth naming.

name: Own the call, love the room
mechanism: Wanting to own decisions while doing best work among people pulls two ways; the good room lets you lead without isolating you.
trigger_expr: Autonomy-need high AND With-others → fire.
render_template: You want to own the decision, and you do your best work surrounded by people. Those pull against each other — your good rooms let you lead without isolating you.

name: Ideas come alive out loud
mechanism: When thinking sharpens in dialogue, the capacity surfaces through telling, not through the solo artifact.
trigger_expr: With-others AND Narrative capacity → fire.
render_template: Your thinking sharpens when you talk it through — so your ideas can look stronger in the room than on the page alone. Build in the telling; don’t just hand over the artifact.

name: Thinks by making
mechanism: An experimental disposition routes ideas through prototypes; the making IS the thinking, so documents lag the object.
trigger_expr: Experiment AND Making capability → fire.
render_template: You think by making. Your ideas become legible when there’s a prototype to point at — so lead with the thing and let the writing follow.

name: The direction signal
mechanism: Not a standalone authored rule — computed by the proximity engine (role-fit 0.65 / domain-fit 0.35 over the full profile). Listed here to complete the type taxonomy.
trigger_expr: proximity engine ranks directions; top-N surface. Fork only at Phase 4.
sibling_or_null: Never an identity noun. Rendered as verb-patterns (“work that…”).
render_template: Rendered as directions, never “You are a [role].” The headline draws its verb-pattern partly from the top convergence signal.
